This service is powered by the Meta m2/m100-1.2b model, running on a privately deployed server.

• No personal data is collected or stored
• Translation text is processed in real-time and not retained
• No user tracking or analytics

This is a free resource. Each user is limited to 120 requests per day to ensure fair access. Limits may be adjusted based on server capacity.

This service integrates multiple open-source datasets and third-party APIs to provide multilingual dictionary lookup.

• Datasets: English WordNet (CC BY 4.0), Chinese-Xinhua (MIT License), ECDICT (MIT License), DBnary (CC BY-SA 4.0), Arabic WordNet 4.0 (Academic use), Kaikki (CC BY-SA 4.0)
• Third-party APIs: Free Dictionary API (MIT), Wiktionary REST API (CC BY-SA 4.0), apihz, Siwar

• No personal data is collected or stored
• Lookup text is processed in real-time and not retained
• No user tracking or analytics

This is a free resource. Each user is limited to 120 lookups per day to ensure fair access. Limits may be adjusted based on server capacity.
